reef-credit-exchange.name: ReefCredit Exchange
reef-credit-exchange.description: A marketplace that tokenizes verified coral reef restoration outcomes and sells carbon-adjacent biodiversity credits to hotels, insurers, and coastal governments. Field partners upload sensor + dive logs; ReefCredit issues tradable certificates.
reef-credit-exchange.businessModel: Takes 8–12% transaction fee on credit sales plus SaaS seats for verification dashboards sold to resorts and municipal buyers.
reef-credit-exchange.fundingRoundNote: Led by regional climate fund with tourism LPs
reef-credit-exchange.goForwardSummary: Offer to become the franchise verification hub in your coastal city—run dive-partner onboarding and sell credits to local hotels while the parent platform handles settlement.

nightshift-nursing-ai.name: Nightshift Nursing AI
nightshift-nursing-ai.description: Ambient voice assistant for overnight hospital wards that drafts nursing notes, flags deterioration risk from vitals chatter, and hands a structured brief to the morning team. Built for staffing-scarce acute care units.
nightshift-nursing-ai.businessModel: Per-bed annual license sold to hospital systems; premium tier includes EHR write-back connectors.
nightshift-nursing-ai.goForwardSummary: Copy the core night-ward workflow for Asian private hospital chains; localize language packs (JP/KR/ZH) and start with ICU wards where English charting already exists.

kiln-microfactory.name: Kiln Microfactory
kiln-microfactory.description: Shared neighborhood ceramic + metal 3D-print microfactories that let designers upload CAD, pick materials, and get same-week small-batch production without owning machines. Targets indie hardware brands and architecture studios.
kiln-microfactory.businessModel: Machine utilization fees + materials margin + optional design-to-manufacture concierge retainers.
kiln-microfactory.goForwardSummary: Franchise a microfactory bay in your city using their software stack—own the local designer relationships while licensing Kiln’s job scheduler and materials pricing.

farmstack-coldchain.name: FarmStack Coldchain
farmstack-coldchain.description: Solar-backed modular cold rooms and IoT spoilage sensors for smallholder produce aggregators. Farmers rent slots by the crate; buyers get quality-assured supply windows via WhatsApp + app.
farmstack-coldchain.businessModel: Hardware lease + per-crate cold storage fees + marketplace take-rate when buyers book lots.
farmstack-coldchain.goForwardSummary: Ask the founding team for cooperation as their Southeast Asia or South Asia licensed operator—replicate the crate rental model with local solar EPC partners.

elderloop-companion.name: ElderLoop Companion
elderloop-companion.description: Tablet + wearable companion that runs daily check-ins for seniors living alone, alerts family on anomaly patterns, and books local caregiver visits. Emphasis on voice-first UX and low-friction family dashboards.
elderloop-companion.businessModel: Monthly subscription per household; caregiver agencies pay for lead referrals and roster tools.
elderloop-companion.goForwardSummary: Offer the same stack to a different age group—young remote workers caring for parents abroad—or rebundle as a corporate EAP benefit for employees with overseas elders.

ledgerlane-freight.name: LedgerLane Freight
ledgerlane-freight.description: AI documentation layer that auto-builds customs packets, bills of lading, and compliance trails for cross-border SME exporters. Integrates with WhatsApp document drops and common ERPs.
ledgerlane-freight.businessModel: Per-shipment SaaS fee + premium compliance insurance upsell with partner underwriters.
ledgerlane-freight.goForwardSummary: Offer it as white-label compliance middleware to freight forwarders and banks in your market rather than competing for end SME logos directly.

playpane-classroom.name: PlayPane Classroom
playpane-classroom.description: Physical STEM kits synced to a teacher dashboard for after-school programs. Kids build electronics projects; the app tracks mastery and recommends next kits. Strong foothold in UK academy trusts.
playpane-classroom.businessModel: Kit hardware margin + annual classroom software seats sold to schools and franchise tutoring centers.
playpane-classroom.goForwardSummary: Copy the kit + dashboard model for Asian enrichment centers; localize curriculum to contest pathways (Olympiads) and sell through tutoring franchise networks.

voltpath-depot.name: VoltPath Depot
voltpath-depot.description: Battery-swap depots for last-mile delivery fleets using standardized packs. Couriers swap in under two minutes; VoltPath owns pack inventory and sells energy-as-a-service to logistics brands.
voltpath-depot.businessModel: Per-swap fees + monthly fleet SLA contracts; residual value from second-life pack sales.
voltpath-depot.goForwardSummary: Offer to become franchise depot operator in your city—VoltPath supplies packs and software; you secure land and courier contracts.

cuecraft-ads.name: CueCraft Ads
cuecraft-ads.description: Generative ad studio that turns a product URL into localized creative packs for Meta, TikTok, and Xiaohongshu—complete with compliance checks for claim language by market.
cuecraft-ads.businessModel: Seat-based SaaS for agencies + usage credits for render volume; enterprise SSO plans.
cuecraft-ads.fundingRoundNote: North America seed with Asia GTM angels
cuecraft-ads.goForwardSummary: Spin out a vertical niche—e.g. beauty D2C only—with Xiaohongshu-native templates and sell to agencies that already specialize in that category.

harbor-legal-ops.name: Harbor Legal Ops
harbor-legal-ops.description: Workflow OS for boutique immigration and visa law firms: client intake, document checklists, deadline calendars, and encrypted client chat. Cuts admin hours so lawyers bill more advisory time.
harbor-legal-ops.businessModel: Per-lawyer monthly SaaS; premium e-signature and government form fillers as add-ons.
harbor-legal-ops.goForwardSummary: Ask the founding team for cooperation as their APAC reseller—bundle Harbor with your local immigration consultancy network and share MRR.

spore-kitchen.name: Spore Kitchen
spore-kitchen.description: Precision fermentation startup producing dairy-identical proteins for ice cream and creamers without cows. Selling B2B ingredients to CPG brands seeking cleaner Scope 3 narratives.
spore-kitchen.businessModel: Ingredient supply contracts with volume tiers; co-development fees for custom formulations.
spore-kitchen.goForwardSummary: License the fermentation strain + process IP for a regional plant instead of importing finished protein—partner with a local CPG co-packer.

meshpay-remit.name: MeshPay Remit
meshpay-remit.description: Low-fee remittance rails using local bank partners and stablecoin settlement between Brazil and African corridors. Focus on micro-merchant payouts for diaspora e-commerce sellers.
meshpay-remit.businessModel: FX + transfer fee spread; float yield on settlement balances; API fees for marketplace integrations.
meshpay-remit.goForwardSummary: Copy the corridor design for Asia–Africa remittance lanes (e.g. Singapore/HK → East Africa) using the same merchant-payout positioning.

bushfire-mesh-sensors.name: Bushfire Mesh Sensors
bushfire-mesh-sensors.description: Low-power mesh sensors and satellite uplinks that detect early heat signatures and smoke plumes across rural fire belts. Alerts feed into local CFA/SES dashboards and insurer loss models.
bushfire-mesh-sensors.businessModel: Hardware + annual monitoring SaaS sold to councils and utilities; data licensing to insurers.
bushfire-mesh-sensors.goForwardSummary: Port the mesh + alert stack to Southeast Asian peat-fire corridors, pairing with local telco LoRaWAN partners.

hanok-energy-retrofit.name: Hanok Energy Retrofit
hanok-energy-retrofit.description: Modular insulation and heat-pump kits designed for traditional Korean courtyard homes, sold with subsidized financing and municipal rebate paperwork automation.
hanok-energy-retrofit.businessModel: Kit margin + installation partner take-rate + SaaS for rebate filing sold to contractors.
hanok-energy-retrofit.goForwardSummary: Franchise install crews in secondary Korean cities first, then adapt kits for Japanese wooden stock.

atelier-carbon-ledger.name: Atelier Carbon Ledger
atelier-carbon-ledger.description: Scope-3 accounting OS for French luxury maisons that maps supplier ateliers, materials, and logistics into audit-ready carbon ledgers for CSRD reporting.
atelier-carbon-ledger.businessModel: Enterprise SaaS seats + per-SKU footprint calculation credits; auditor co-sell revenue share.
atelier-carbon-ledger.goForwardSummary: Spin a ready-to-wear-only SKU module and sell it to mid-market brands that cannot afford full maison deployments.

mercado-voice-pos.name: Mercado Voice POS
mercado-voice-pos.description: Voice-first point-of-sale for Mexican tiendas and street vendors: speak inventory and sales in Spanish, sync to WhatsApp receipts, and unlock micro-working-capital lines.
mercado-voice-pos.businessModel: Hardware kit margin + monthly SaaS + interest share on embedded credit with bank partners.
mercado-voice-pos.goForwardSummary: Reuse the voice POS UX for Bahasa/Tagalog informal retail corridors with local telco wallets.

cape-clinic-triage.name: Cape Clinic Triage
cape-clinic-triage.description: WhatsApp + USSD triage bots that route township patients to the right clinic queue, with nurse dashboards and ambulance ETA sharing for Cape Town metro clinics.
cape-clinic-triage.businessModel: Per-clinic SaaS + provincial health system licenses; optional telehealth upsell.
cape-clinic-triage.goForwardSummary: Partner as the East Africa deployment operator—localize USSD flows and clinic integrations while Cape Clinic owns the core engine.

fjord-battery-secondlife.name: Fjord Battery SecondLife
fjord-battery-secondlife.description: Repurposes EV packs from Nordic fleets into modular home and cabin storage with remote diagnostics and grid ancillary services bidding.
fjord-battery-secondlife.businessModel: Pack refurb margin + monthly energy-as-a-service; grid services revenue share.
fjord-battery-secondlife.goForwardSummary: License the BMS + diagnostics stack to Asian EV OEMs seeking EU second-life compliance pathways.

saigon-microgrid-coops.name: Saigon Microgrid Co-ops
saigon-microgrid-coops.description: Solar + storage co-ops for Vietnamese industrial parks that pool rooftops, settle energy credits on-chain lite, and sell surplus to the grid under DPPA rules.
saigon-microgrid-coops.businessModel: Project development fees + ongoing co-op management SaaS + energy trading spread.
saigon-microgrid-coops.fundingRoundNote: SEA climate fund + industrial park LPs
saigon-microgrid-coops.goForwardSummary: Franchise co-op formation playbooks to secondary Vietnamese cities and Cambodian border parks.

iron-dome-devsecops.name: Iron Lattice DevSecOps
iron-dome-devsecops.description: Continuous security pipeline for Israeli deep-tech startups that maps SBOM, cloud misconfig, and red-team findings into board-ready risk scores for Series A diligence.
iron-dome-devsecops.businessModel: Per-engineer SaaS + premium pen-test credits; VC diligence white-label plans.
iron-dome-devsecops.goForwardSummary: Sell the diligence white-label pack to regional VCs and corporate venture arms rather than chasing every startup logo.
